dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Problem (edge-EP property characterization for planar graph expansions)
dossier_meta.statement_text: Finding a characterization for the planar graphs $J$ such that $J$-expansions have the edge-Erd\H{o}s-P\'osa property remains an intriguing open problem.
dossier_meta.context_text: Robertson and Seymour showed that $J$-expansions have the vertex-EP property if and only if $J$ is planar. By contrast, it was shown in [4] that there exist planar graphs $J$ — in particular sufficiently large ladders and subcubic trees with sufficiently large pathwidth — for which $J$-expansions do not have the edge-EP property. The precise characterization of which planar $J$ yield the edge-EP property is unknown.
